key_insight: A two-layer control framework combining dynamic pricing and multi-agent deep reinforcement learning can improve battery operation in dairy farms while balancing profit, renewable integration, and grid constraints.
engineering_relevance: The method targets practical distributed energy management in rural dairy networks, showing how AI control can support decarbonization without violating voltage limits.
method: Upper layer: dynamic pricing and multi-objective optimization using differential evolution.
Lower layer: multi-agent deep reinforcement learning for battery management.
Electrical behavior evaluated in a simulated rural distribution circuit.
evidence_signal: In simulation, the proposed framework improved energy-arbitrage profits by up to 18% over rule-based control, increased distributed generation use, and remained within Irish grid-code voltage limits.
watch_item: Results are simulation-based, so field validation is still needed to confirm robustness under real farm loads, market conditions, and battery degradation effects.
paper_title: Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi Objective Battery Management in Dairy Farms
